description: The first pancakes: flour and egg (and chocolate) mixed, then fried. Two sections at the top over a pit, the mixers, pans and eggs below. The staircases down vanish every thirty-five seconds, and portals take chefs between the top and the bottom.
strategy: One chef makes pancakes at the bottom; the other washes, plates and serves up top, and throws chocolate across the pit from the left section to the right. Throw flour down carefully: the bin and the right-hand mixer are both where it lands.
